summary.text: William Sharer is a Republican who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2001, representing District 1 in San Juan County, and is the Senate Minority Floor Leader.
Sharer is ranking member of the Senate Indian, Rural and Cultural Affairs Committee and also sits on the Senate Tax, Business and Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Sharer's occupation as small business owner and a district office in Farmington.

Between sessions, Sharer is a member of the Legislative Council, the Indian Affairs Committee, the Interim Legislative Ethics Committee and the Revenue Stabilization and Tax Policy Committee, among others.
